name: pi-extensions-workspace
description: Bun workspace for independently published Pi extensions

scripts.build:all: bun run build:packages && bun run build:extensions
scripts.build:packages: bun run --cwd packages/shared-settings build && bun run --cwd packages/workspace-files build
scripts.build:extensions: bun run --cwd extensions/background-tasks build && bun run --cwd extensions/codex-api build && bun run --cwd extensions/cursor-effect build && bun run --cwd extensions/pwsh-adapter build && bun run --cwd extensions/ssh-remote build && bun run --cwd extensions/thinking-fold build && bun run --cwd extensions/todo build
scripts.test: bun run build:packages && node --import tsx --test --test-isolation=process tests/background-tasks.test.ts tests/codex-api.test.ts tests/cursor-effect.test.ts tests/shared-settings.test.ts tests/workspace-files.test.ts tests/ssh-remote.test.ts tests/ssh-remote-windows-integration.test.ts tests/thinking-fold.test.ts tests/todo.test.ts tests/packages.test.ts
scripts.check: bun run check:privacy && bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.pack:check: bun run check && bun run pack:shared-settings && bun run pack:workspace-files && bun run pack:background-tasks && bun run pack:codex-api && bun run pack:cursor-effect && bun run pack:pwsh-adapter && bun run pack:ssh-remote && bun run pack:thinking-fold && bun run pack:todo

author: 99percentpeople
